meta.purpose: Primary instruments every obligation template and regulatory threshold derives from. A sign-off cites a source id and the digest of the exact bytes reviewed.
meta.mirroring: A human downloads the instrument from `url`, saves it under app/content/mirror/, and runs `python -m app.content.pipeline mirror <id> <file> --by "Name, ACS 12345"`. Nothing here is fetched automatically.
meta.warning: Secondary summaries are not sources. Law-firm notes and news write-ups have been observed conflating the 29 Apr 2026 Amendment Directions with an SBR layer revision, which they are not.

sources.citation: RBI Master Direction — Non-Banking Financial Company – Scale Based Regulation Directions, 2023
sources.note: Governs the Base/Middle/Upper layer boundaries. Para 2.7 and its footnote read references to NBFC-ND-SI as NBFC-ML/UL and place existing ND-SIs of Rs.500cr-Rs.1000cr in the Base Layer. Source for sbr_middle_layer_asset_cr and ndsi_asset_cr.

sources.citation: RBI (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Registration, Exemptions and Framework for Scale Based Regulation) Directions, 2025
sources.note: Consolidating directions amended by the 29 Apr 2026 Amendment below.

sources.citation: RBI (NBFC – Registration, Exemptions and Framework for Scale Based Regulation) Amendment Directions, 2026
sources.note: In force 1 Jul 2026. Creates the Unregistered Type I NBFC category and opens a CoR surrender window to 30 Sep 2026. Registration relief — NOT a Base/Middle/Upper layer revision, despite the title carrying 'Scale Based Regulation'. Confirm before letting it touch any layer constant.

sources.citation: RBI circular — Reporting to the Central Repository of Information on Large Credits (CRILC) by NBFCs
sources.note: Scope reportedly deposit-taking NBFCs plus non-deposit-taking at Rs.500cr and above, independent of SBR layer. Source for rbi_crilc and rbi_crilc_sma_weekly. The layer-independence is the specific claim to verify.

sources.citation: RBI/2023-24/112 — Credit/Investment Concentration Norms – Credit Risk Transfer
sources.note: Harmonised concentration computation across Base and Middle Layers; Base Layer keeps a Board-approved internal policy with no prescribed numerical ceilings. Source for sbr_concentration_policy_bl and rbi_concentration.

sources.citation: RBI circular — Compliance Function and Role of Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) – NBFCs
sources.note: Applies to NBFC-UL and NBFC-ML. Source for sbr_cco. Dated 2022, not 2026 — the CCO requirement is four years old and must never be pitched as new.
Board oversight, committee composition, KMP compensation with mandatory deferral. First governance-specific penalty followed on 9 Mar 2026.
Three independent triggers: turnover, net worth, net profit. csr_turnover_cr models only the turnover limb; the other two are unmodelled.

sources.citation: CGST Rules — Quarterly Return Monthly Payment (QRMP) scheme eligibility
sources.note: An eligibility ceiling, not an automatic classification — QRMP is an election. Source for gst_qrmp_turnover_cr.

sources.citation: Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 — section 2(12), as applied by state notification
sources.note: State-varying: several states notify 20 rather than 10. esi_employee_count is a single national constant and therefore a known simplification.
